Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 20
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated the lifespans and drew the wrong conclusion. Using the cited dates, Antonio Caggiano (1889-01-30 to 1979-10-23) lived about 90 years and 9 months, while Hardyal Singh (1928-11-28 to 2018-08-17) lived about 89 years and 9 months. The Planner incorrectly stated Hardyal Singh lived longer and marked the task complete.
